open_threads.thread: Einarsson v. Canada (ICSID Case No. UNCT/20/6): NAFTA Chapter 11 claim on proprietary seismic data as IP (copyright/trade-secret) investment; Canada's regulatory-disclosure regime challenged; NAFTA Article 1121 waiver objection pending; merits hearing concluded March 2025 — monitor for award.

Trade-secret / clinical-data gap: No publicly known ISDS case has yet asserted pharmaceutical trade secrets or clinical trial data as the primary covered investment — the Ferguson/Kim framework remains theoretical; track any new filing under BITs or CPTPP.

Treaty architecture closure: USMCA/CUSMA lapsed US-Canada ISDS after 30 June 2023; CPTPP pharmaceutical test data exclusivity provisions (TPP Art. 18.50) suspended — no direct ISDS hook for clinical data under either major multilateral framework. UK CPTPP accession (Dec 2024) adds investor pool without restoring suspended provisions. Monitor older bilateral BITs and any new ICSID/UNCITRAL pharmaceutical IP registration; monitor Mexico USMCA Art. 20.48 clinical-data non-implementation for Chapter 31 or Annex 14-D proceedings.

China NMPA 2026 pharmaceutical data exclusivity: clinical trial data and marketing-authorization registration certificates are now formally protectable and tradable under Chinese law (effective May 2026), establishing a Ring 1 foundation; monitor for ISDS claims if protections are subsequently restricted or unevenly applied.

Ring 3 doctrine — abuse of rights / DOB gap: Jason Yu Song v. China (PCA 2019-39, Jan 2025) reveals natural-person nationality-planning gap in DOB clause architecture analogous to Philip Morris corporate restructuring. UNCITRAL Working Group III Draft Provision 17 (denial of benefits reform) appeared stalled at April 2025 session — risk of reframing to codify only existing practice rather than closing the gap. Track WG III subsequent sessions and any IP-related case that triggers this doctrine.
